notes.title: v1.2.1 Update
notes.notes: We've updated BattleLore: Command to version 1.2.1! This update addresses a couple of minor bug fixes - most notably the win/loss notification that fires at the end of a battle. Please update to v1.2.1 (120017) to ensure online multiplayer compatibility.
